description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rohanagama, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710080 (24/0735)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various locations, making it primarily concerned with land and property matters. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement making determinations about land ownership, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
